svg.title: NET-07 — Guest reconnect with 24 seconds remaining
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 client. A centered 640-pixel reconnect panel overlays the retained last confirmed network arena. It shows the endpoint, a positive reservation countdown, reserved-player status, both active-round continuation notices, and focused Leave session. Accepted player appearance and effect state remain retained without receiver-profile lookup, rerandomization, or advancing effects; current restoration uses the accepted snapshot under NET-VIS-022–024. The retained world is not presented as current. Host/controller, lobby and summary variations remain annotations and owning-contract states, not new layouts.

g.text: Reserved players receive no input and remain in play
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Last accepted player appearances and effects remain frozen context; the host's match continues.
Panel maximum width: 640 client px; minimum client-edge clearance: 16 px. Heading, positive countdown and action stay visible.
Endpoint/prose wrap inside the body. Active seconds use the positive ceiling, never 0. Leave opens the existing consequence confirmation.
Dedicated Host uses End session in the same action position and its control/expiry consequence; both active-round notices remain.
Lobby/summary retain their actual context. No Pause, migration, password display, new identity or deadline extension is introduced.
